claims.explanation: Norethindrone acetate is a progesterone receptor (PGR) agonist, and its selective antiproliferative/killing pattern is best explained by PGR expression: lines that express PGR (e.g., T47D breast cancer, which is PGR-positive and was among the least affected) are growth-inhibited or growth-arrested rather than killed, while PGR-negative lines lack this cytostatic brake and are more vulnerable to the drug's non-genomic or off-target cytotoxic effects. The most sensitive lines shown are predominantly PGR-negative tumor types (melanoma, NSCLC, mesothelioma, sarcoma, glioma, osteosarcoma), whereas the least affected include known PGR-positive breast/endometrial lines, consistent with PGR expression being protective against cytotoxicity at this concentration.

features.basis: PGR-positive lines (e.g., T47D) are among the least affected; PGR-negative lines dominate the most killed, consistent with receptor-mediated cytostasis rather than killing
Estrogen receptor-positive, hormone-responsive lineages (breast, endometrium) are overrepresented among least affected lines, suggesting hormone-receptor signaling buffers progestin cytotoxicity
TP53 mutation is nearly universal in the most-killed lines and absent in several least-affected lines, consistent with loss of p53-mediated survival after progestin-induced stress
BRAF-mutant melanoma and other BRAF-mutant lines (IGR37, A2058, IPC298, NMCG1, OV90) are enriched among the most killed
PTEN loss appears in several highly sensitive lines (A2058, FTC133), suggesting PI3K/AKT-driven dependence increases progestin lethality
RB1 mutation is present in multiple most-killed lines (A2058, FTC133, SF539), consistent with loss of cell-cycle checkpoint control enhancing sensitivity
CDKN2A deletion/mutation appears in sensitive lines (KELLY, IPC298), suggesting impaired senescence/apoptosis regulation increases killing
ARID1A mutation is present in several most-killed lines (OVTOKO, SNU685) but also in some resistant lines, so this is weaker evidence
NF1 mutation appears in multiple sensitive lines (BICR6, FTC133, YD8), suggesting RAS/MAPK activation contributes to sensitivity
KRAS mutation is present in several most-killed lines (RKN, CL11), though also in some resistant lines, making this a weaker feature
ALK alteration appears in sensitive lines (NCIH2452, KELLY) but also in resistant SKNSH, so evidence is mixed and weak
PIK3CA mutation is enriched among least-affected lines (T47D, RT112, BT474, VMCUB1, 22RV1, SNU719, HT115), suggesting PI3K activation supports survival under progestin treatment
